body.name: Primitive three-horizon marked-capacity exhibit
body.construction: Let \(\mathfrak E_3\) have \(\tau=3\), degenerate \(X\), \(Z\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\) independent of all potential times, \(C=3\), death categories \((d_i^\star)_{i=0}^3=(1/2,3/2,5/2,\infty)\), treated-readmission categories \((r_j^\star)_{j=0}^3=(1/4,5/4,9/4,\infty)\), and \(R(0)=\infty\). With death rows and readmission columns, the within-arm tables are \(100\mu_0^\star=\begin{pmatrix}0&0&0&25\\0&0&0&25\\0&0&0&25\\0&0&0&25\end{pmatrix}\) and \(100\mu_1^\star=\begin{pmatrix}5&0&0&5\\5&10&0&5\\5&5&10&10\\10&5&5&20\end{pmatrix}\). Every marked survivor capacity after death cuts \(k=0,1,2\) is displayed by \(100\kappa^\star=\begin{pmatrix}20&20&15&35\\15&10&15&30\\10&5&5&20\end{pmatrix}\); the capacity for any readmission-mark set is the sum of its displayed columns. Define \(100f^-=\begin{pmatrix}10&0&10&5\\0&10&5&10\\15&5&0&5\\0&5&0&20\end{pmatrix}\) and \(100f^+=\begin{pmatrix}5&0&10&10\\10&15&0&0\\0&0&0&25\\10&5&5&5\end{pmatrix}\). Both have row sums \((25,25,25,25)\) and column sums \((25,20,15,40)\). Their complete chain-arc loads \(100(\sum_{i>k}f^-_{ij})_{kj}=\begin{pmatrix}15&20&5&35\\15&10&0&25\\0&5&0&20\end{pmatrix}\) and \(100(\sum_{i>k}f^+_{ij})_{kj}=\begin{pmatrix}20&20&5&30\\10&5&5&30\\10&5&5&5\end{pmatrix}\) are entrywise bounded by \(100\kappa^\star\). Explicit full lifts, with all unlisted entries zero, are \(100(q^-_{000},q^-_{003},q^-_{010},q^-_{022},q^-_{111},q^-_{113},q^-_{123},q^-_{132},q^-_{220},q^-_{221},q^-_{223},q^-_{230},q^-_{331},q^-_{333})=(5,5,5,10,10,5,5,5,5,5,5,10,5,20)\) and \(100(q^+_{000},q^+_{003},q^+_{013},q^+_{022},q^+_{110},q^+_{111},q^+_{120},q^+_{121},q^+_{223},q^+_{233},q^+_{330},q^+_{331},q^+_{332},q^+_{333})=(5,5,5,10,5,10,5,5,10,15,10,5,5,5)\), where \(q^\pm_{ihj}=\Pr(D(0)=d_i^\star,D(1)=d_h^\star,R(1)=r_j^\star)\); attach \(R(0)=\infty\).
